zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Zones allow you to define a specific area of the frame so you can determine whether or not an object is within a particular area.

motion_masks.title: Motion Masks
motion_masks.description: Motion masks are used to prevent unwanted types of motion from triggering detection. Over masking will make it more difficult for objects to be tracked.

object_masks.title: Object Masks
object_masks.description: Object filter masks are used to filter out false positives for a given object type based on location.
